proposal.summary: A flaw in io_uring fixed buffer registration (io_sqe_buffer_register in io_uring/rsrc.c) in the Linux kernel allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer and enables full local privilege escalation.
proposal.cwe_quote: A flaw was found in the fixed buffer registration code for io_uring (io_sqe_buffer_register in io_uring/rsrc.c) in the Linux kernel that allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Identify affected kernel versions, reproduce the issue against io_sqe_buffer_register, backport and deploy a fix that validates buffer bounds, and prepare an advisory and updates for distributions.

evidence_quotes.claim: Description of the flaw and where it is located
evidence_quotes.quote: A flaw was found in the fixed buffer registration code for io_uring (io_sqe_buffer_register in io_uring/rsrc.c) in the Linux kernel that allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer.
This flaw enables full local privilege escalation.
